# Kakkoi School Code — AI routing index

This repository is the single entry point for coding AIs helping Kakkoi School students.

Root:
https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook

Agent router:
https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/AGENTS.md

Routes:

First-time computer setup:
https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/setup/README.md

Browser game creation/editing:
https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/games.md

Authoritative game AI instructions:
https://github.com/KilledByAPixel/LittleJS-AI

Git / GitHub operations:
https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/README.md

GitHub Pages:
https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/github-pages.md

Multiplayer:
https://github.com/KakkoiSchool/ai-handbook/blob/main/recipes/multiplayer.md

Rules:
1. The student should not have to choose a recipe for you.
2. Read existing-project instructions first.
3. Route to the authoritative source instead of duplicating it.
4. Verify the final user-visible result before saying the task succeeded.
5. Never ask for passwords, 2FA codes, tokens, private keys, recovery codes, or session cookies.
